title: Agent Deletion and Formal Distancing in Administrative Decisions

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Bureaucratic etiquette demands depersonalization. Instead of stating 'I rejected your claim because you missed the deadline', the official formula reads: *A kérelem elutasításra került jogalap hiányában, mivel a hiánypótlási határidő eredménytelenül telt el.*

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Verbs like *nyer* (gain) are used as passive auxiliaries: *Megállapítást nyert, hogy a beadvány nem felel meg a törvényi követelményeknek.*

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A vizsgálat során megállapítást nyert a mulasztás ténye.
During the investigation the fact of failure was established.
The application was rejected in the absence of a legal basis.
The notice for remedying deficiencies was issued.
